name: cobol-procedure-division-model-limits
body: parse_procedure_division diagnoses and drops a program's statements before its first paragraph, while parse_method_procedure_division keeps a METHOD-ID body's leading statements as a paragraph named <method-body> that is never a procedure target; it parses then drops a declarative USE sentence, records no ALTER operands (neither as refs nor as transfers), keeps no IF/EVALUATE branch structure, and excludes one shared closed set of COBOL-85 phrase and operand keywords plus the word after FUNCTION from statement refs. Limit: a program written without paragraph names loses those statements, ALTER targets and USE file references are lost, and a non-standard program using one of the shared keywords as a data name loses that reference. Upgrade when a corpus shows paragraph-less programs, or when facts need ALTER or USE targets or per-verb keyword sets.
